disposition: Reject direct TPS3702CX33/CX50 selection for a universally compatible qualification boundary.

TPS3702.outputs: Independent active-low open drains; joining them forms a common fault.
TPS3702.timing_conditions: VDD=2V, 2.5% overdrive, RPU=10k; no minimum/maximum entries.
TPS3702.rounding_note: Enclose rounded and percentage nominal trips; rounding union does not resolve the accuracy-basis difference. Table 10-2 hysteresis is not the specified maximum.

accuracy_presentation_difference.section_6_3_3: Adds accuracy percentage to nominal rail window: +/-4% becomes +/-4.9%.
accuracy_presentation_difference.inference: Application example is consistent with trip-relative accuracy; source presentation does not resolve a unique guaranteed silicon bound.

TPS3808.reset_output: Open drain; asserted by low SENSE or MR, released after both recover and delay expires.
TPS3808.POR_conditions: VOL<=0.2V at15uA; power-up note requires Trise(VDD)>=15us/V.

TPS3703.startup_note: VDD must remain >=VDD(min) for startup plus release delay; no startup maximum specified.
TPS3703.limitation_inference: Bounded step detection does not establish arbitrary near-threshold, rail-collapse or startup behavior; full window/recovery corners remain unreviewed.

TPS3700.role: Adjustable-window alternative under investigation, not selected.
TPS3700.startup_conditions: VDD exceeds 1.8V for specified delay before correct outputs.
TPS3700.propagation_conditions: VDD=5V, 10mV overdrive, RPU=10k, VOH=0.9VDD, VOL=400mV; directions refer to sense inputs, not universal fault/release.
TPS3700.limitation_inference: Requires divider tolerance/bias and retention review; startup maximum does not create a guaranteed detection maximum.

SN74LVC1G17.role: Schmitt edge-conditioner alternative under investigation, not selected.
SN74LVC1G17.propagation_conditions: VCC=3.3V +/-0.3V; Table 5-4 and Figure 6-2 test waveform/loading apply.
SN74LVC1G17.limitation_inference: Schmitt hysteresis can condition slow inputs; output slew/loading, below-operating-supply behavior and ACT-04 event ordering still need qualification.

method.error_basis: Main screen follows section 6.3.3 rail-referenced error; separate trip-relative sensitivity follows the Table 7-1 example. Neither interpretation is asserted as the definitive guaranteed silicon bound.
method.nominal_union: Each method encloses percentage-defined and rounded-table nominal trips before applying its own error basis; this addresses rounding only.
method.hysteresis: Check recovery separately using its maximum specified magnitude. A rail may avoid new faults yet fail to release a prior fault.
method.regulator_limits: Recorded feedback/PWM screens exclude complete dynamic, aging and PFM bounds; typical no-load offset is not a worst-case addition.
method.rail_5V_comparison_corridor: 4.5..5.5V is a proposed signal-performance comparison corridor, not the TXU recommended operating range, an absolute maximum range or a proven board limit.
method.selection_conclusion: Direct fixed-window selection remains rejected under either screened interpretation; interpretation-dependent static margins are not hardware acceptance.

design_inferences: Tight C windows overlap the recorded initial converter screens; independent trip and converter corners can cause nuisance faults.
Wide CX33 thresholds do not enforce the selected 3.0..3.6V logic timing interval.
Wide CX50 margin against the proposed 5V performance corridor depends on accuracy interpretation; neither static screen proves dynamic protection.
A release timer cannot detect faults missed by its input, nor repair unknown maximum detector latency.
Open-drain outputs require slew conditioning and leakage/loading review before ACT-04 LVC inputs.
QUAL_OK and ACK remain undriven/default low; remote readiness and command freshness are unimplemented.
acceptance_holds: Threshold and hysteresis margins with complete regulator operating envelopes.
Guaranteed detection conditions, retained-fault duration and reset release.
Startup, fast collapse, independently missing supplies and pin backdrive.
Conditioned ACK/ARM/reset timing and complete OE/receiver stopping budget.
Actual receiver identities and independent watchdog/ready permissions.
